title: Parallax Assembly Manifest
description: Maps every second of a Parallax episode to a visual element, bridging the two-column production script and the Remotion full-episode composition. Generated by tools/assembly/generate-manifest.py, consumed by src/templates/Episodes/FullEpisode.tsx.

title.description: Episode title for display, e.g. 'The Silicon Trap'.

fps.description: Frame rate. Must match layout.fps in theme.ts (currently 30).

totalDurationSec.description: Total episode duration in seconds. Computed from narration length + padding.

mode.description: How timing was derived. 'estimate' = from script hints and word count. 'precise' = from Whisper narration timestamps.

audioFile.description: Path to narration audio file, relative to the episode data directory. Null in estimate mode.

totalDurationSec.description: Total narration audio duration in seconds.

words.description: Word-level timestamps from WhisperX (phoneme-level alignment, ±50ms). Empty in estimate mode.

beats.description: Beat boundaries for structural reference. Not used for rendering — segments carry their own timing.

filmOverlay.description: Episode-level film overlay config. Wraps all visual layers with cinematic texture effects (grain, vignette, light-leak, etc.).

preset.description: Named preset from FilmOverlayPresets.ts. If specified, effects and intensity are derived from the preset.

effects.description: Which effects to enable. Overrides preset if both specified.

intensity.description: Overall intensity (0-1). Overrides preset if both specified.

lowerThird.description: Episode-level lower-third config. When present, renders a LowerThird per beat with the specified label and timing.

label.description: Label shown on all lower-thirds, e.g. '∴ PARALLAX · EP.01'.

accentColor.description: Accent color for the vertical line (default: gold #C4A747).

enterDelaySec.description: Seconds after beat start to show lower-third.

musicBed.description: Episode-level music bed definition (Layer 1). Continuous ambient music tracks with crossfade transitions at beat boundaries.

tracks.description: Ordered list of music bed tracks. Tracks may overlap by their fade durations to create crossfade transitions.

file.description: Path to audio file relative to episode data directory.

startSec.description: Start time in seconds from episode start.

endSec.description: End time in seconds from episode start.

volume.description: Base volume (0-1). Typically 0.10-0.15 under narration, 0.20-0.30 during visual-only moments.

mood.description: Mood category for sourcing reference. See AUDIO_DESIGN.md for mood → tempo/key mapping.

beat.description: Which narrative beat this track covers, e.g. 'opening', 'beat1', 'closing'.

segments.description: Ordered list of visual segments. Segments may overlap (e.g. a TEMPLATE over FOOTAGE). Z-order convention: all background-layer segments render first (z=0), then all foreground-layer segments render on top (z=1). Within the same layer, later segments in the array render on top of earlier ones. HOLD segments sustain the previous visual. In FullEpisode.tsx, background segments are rendered as the first set of <Sequence> blocks, foreground as the second set.

type.description: FOOTAGE = stock video, IMAGE = still photo/archival, TEMPLATE = Remotion motion graphic, TRANSITION = beat title card (TitleTransition), HOLD = sustain previous visual (e.g. dramatic pause on stat).

startSec.description: Start time in seconds from episode start.

endSec.description: End time in seconds from episode start.

layer.description: 'background' = full-bleed behind narration (footage, images). 'foreground' = motion graphic overlay (templates, transitions). Multiple background segments at the same time = last one wins. Foreground renders on top.

beat.description: Which beat this segment belongs to, e.g. 'beat1', 'beat2'.

priority.description: Production priority from the script. P1 = essential, P2 = important, P3 = nice-to-have.

narrationRef.description: The narration paragraph this visual accompanies, for alignment debugging. First ~80 chars of the narration text.

asset.description: For FOOTAGE and IMAGE segments. References sourced media.

searchTerms.description: Fallback search terms from the script, in priority order.

file.description: Resolved file path after sourcing. Null until asset is sourced.

status.description: Asset resolution status. 'pending' = not yet sourced, 'resolved' = file available, 'failed' = sourcing attempted but unsuccessful.

placeholder.description: Fallback rendering when asset is pending/failed. 'solid-color' = branded dark background with segment ID label. 'last-frame' = sustain the last rendered frame.

fallbackColor.description: Hex color for solid-color placeholder. Defaults to dark.bg.base (#0D0D1A).

treatment.description: Brand treatment for FOOTAGE and IMAGE segments.

opacity.description: Override opacity. If omitted, uses composite mode default from BrandImage.

template.description: For TEMPLATE and TRANSITION segments. References a Remotion composition.

dataFile.description: JSON data file path relative to data/episodes/<slug>/, e.g. 'kinetic-92-yield.json'.

hold.description: For HOLD segments. Sustains the previous visual.

freeze.description: If true, freeze the last frame. If false, let video/animation continue playing.

durationSec.description: Transition duration in seconds. Ignored for cut transitions.

layered.description: Layered composition config — composites this foreground segment over a background segment. Implements the [LAYERED:] visual mode.

backgroundSegmentId.description: ID of the background segment to composite under this foreground.

position.description: Spatial positioning of the foreground layer.

backgroundDim.description: Darken the background so foreground text pops. 0 = no dim.

vignette.description: Add a subtle vignette overlay for depth.

notes.description: Production notes from the script's italicized annotations.

soundCue.description: Primary sound design marker for NLE editor (Layer 2 — transition SFX). Specifies which sound event should accompany this segment's entrance or key moment.

type.description: Sound event type. See AUDIO_DESIGN.md for the full palette.

offsetSec.description: Offset from segment start in seconds. 0 = plays at segment entrance.

intensity.description: Mix level. 'subtle' = barely audible texture, 'dramatic' = momentary foreground.

soundCueSecondary.description: Secondary transition SFX for segments with two distinct audio moments (e.g. entrance + key moment). Same schema as soundCue.

textureCues.description: Micro-SFX markers for template animation events (Layer 3 — texture hits). Each cue fires at a specific offset from segment start. Max 3 hits per 10-second window.

type.description: Texture hit type. See AUDIO_DESIGN.md for descriptions.

offsetSec.description: Offset from segment start in seconds. Texture hits should be timed to match template animation events.

volume.description: Volume (0-0.2). Default 0.08. Texture hits should be 15-20dB below narration.

label.description: Human-readable label for cue sheet, e.g. 'first bar grows', 'Taiwan fills'. Optional.
